name: Cinder Squire
passive_text: +15% ATK against 1★ and 2★ enemies.
lore: A page who never lets the forge go cold.

name: Ash Hound
passive_text: +5% party power for each other Ember card in the party.
lore: It sleeps in the cooling slag and wakes at the smell of iron.

name: Tidepool Sprite
passive_text: Heals the party for 4% of its power after each successful run.
lore: Small enough to hide in a seashell, loud enough to wake a harbour.

name: Drowned Deckhand
passive_text: Reduces dungeon power requirement by 3% while in the party.
lore: Still punching the clock, four fathoms down.

name: Thornling
passive_text: The first failed run each day costs no party fatigue.
lore: Grows a new thorn every time it hears a lie.

name: Mossback Boar
passive_text: +10% gold from the first run of each session.
lore: Its tusks are prized and its temper is not.

name: Shade Rat
passive_text: Ignores 10% of enemy DEF.
lore: It eats the light before it eats the grain.

name: Grave Lantern
passive_text: +2% success chance on any run it joins.
lore: Someone lit it to walk a friend home. Nobody has blown it out since.

name: Dawn Acolyte
passive_text: +5% gold on runs shorter than 30 minutes.
lore: Prays at the hour when the sky cannot decide what colour to be.

name: Forge Apprentice
passive_text: +12% ATK for each 4★+ material stack in your vault.
lore: Took the apprenticeship for the sparks and stayed for the scars.

name: Scorchrunner
passive_text: Cuts 5% off dungeon timers.
lore: Burns a path so the party behind it can move faster.

name: Reef Sentinel
passive_text: Absorbs the first failure penalty of each day.
lore: It has stood in the same current for a century and sees no reason to move.

name: Salt Warden
passive_text: +10% material drops from resource dungeons.
lore: Salt keeps its promises: nothing spoils on its watch.

name: Grove Warden
passive_text: +8% party power when three or more factions are present.
lore: Speaks to every tree in the valley by name including the dead ones.

name: Nightblade Acolyte
passive_text: +25% power in the first 10 seconds of a run.
lore: Learned patience first and knives second.

name: Bone Harvester
passive_text: Converts 5% of gold earned into shards for your lowest-rank card.
lore: Counts every rib it has ever collected. The count is not finished.

name: Halo Smith
passive_text: +8% gold on every run.
lore: Forges rings for those who earn them and for those who do not.

name: Magma Brute
passive_text: Refunds 10% of a failed run as bonus gold.
lore: Anger is a fossil fuel and it has reserves.

name: Kraken Spawn
passive_text: +20% reward scaling on boss dungeons.
lore: Eight arms, one idea, and the idea is more food.

name: Bramble Tyrant
passive_text: Failed runs still return 50% of their materials.
lore: Nobody has found the middle of the thicket. Several have found the edges.

name: Rootmother
passive_text: +15% party power for every card under 3★.
lore: She remembers when the valley was a seed.

name: Hollow Knight
passive_text: Ignores 20% of enemy DEF on runs longer than two hours.
lore: The armour is empty and the armour is the only thing still fighting.

name: Dawnbreaker
passive_text: +15% power against boss dungeons.
lore: Rated for one sunrise per battle. It has been known to break the rule.

name: Pyre Warden
passive_text: +20% party power but dungeon timers run 15% longer.
lore: Tends the fire that keeps the dead company.

name: Abyss Oracle
passive_text: +12% success chance in dungeons you have not cleared yet.
lore: Reads the tide's handwriting without turning the page.

name: Verdant Colossus
passive_text: The first failed run each week refunds every material spent on it.
lore: A mountain that agreed to take a walk.

name: Umbral Regent
passive_text: +10% to every drop table while a 5★ card is in the party.
lore: Rules a kingdom that appears only on maps drawn in the dark.

name: Radiant Seraph
passive_text: Converts one boss core into three crystal on demand.
lore: It has six wings and no opinion about your schedule.

name: Ashen Sovereign
passive_text: +30% power on boss dungeons and boss cores are guaranteed on a clear.
lore: The first forge was lit to crown it, not to warm anyone.

name: Worldseed Avatar
passive_text: Every card in the party earns 25% more XP.
lore: Everything you have ever planted was practice for this.
